lines: It was a spring night, and I was alone.
The monochrome sky swallows my sigh.
A hurried tide of people.
I just stared, having waited forever.
Even when the cherry blossoms open, the night is still cold.
I recall your face.
Are you okay? I'm fine, I wave my hand playfully.
The promise we exchanged that day.
We, we, of that waning moon
searching for its missing half.
If we could share our loneliness.
I swear once more.
Sitting on a square bench, I stare blankly at the sky.
I remember, just like yesterday.
Both the modest smiles and the petty arguments
how much they made me stronger?
Since then, since then, of that waning moon
still searching for its half.
Someday, the cherry blossoms will bloom.
toward the full moon.
The changing streets seem to urge us.
Where are you now, what are you doing?
A life of its own, a happiness of its own.
Yet I still chase it.
We, we, of that waning moon
searching for its missing half.
If we could share our loneliness.
Once more...
Since then, since then, of that waning moon
searching for its half.
Someday, the cherry blossoms will bloom.
toward the full moon.
